title: Dev Vault Resource Metadata
description: The single source of truth for resource metadata. Consumed by catalog/schema.json (catalog entries) and enforced by scripts/validate.py. Field semantics are documented in docs/RESOURCE_STANDARD.md.

kebab-case.description: Lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens.

id.description: Stable, unique, never reused. Once published it names exactly one resource forever.

type.description: Resource taxonomy. Must match the first path segment under resources/.

description.description: What the resource does and when to use it. Keywords here are how agents discover the resource.

path.description: Directory under resources/, with trailing slash. Must exist and start with resources/<type>/.

language.description: Implementation languages, e.g. ["python"]. Use ["n/a"] for non-code resources.

technologies.description: Frameworks, tools, or platforms the resource targets.

compatibility.description: Environments the resource is known or expected to work in. ["universal"] means no environment-specific assumptions.

dependencies.description: External runtime dependencies beyond the language runtime itself. Empty list means none.

license.description: "inherit" for the repository MIT license; otherwise an SPDX identifier or explicit license note.

status.description: Lifecycle status. See docs/RESOURCE_STANDARD.md §6 for the stability bar.

version.description: Resource-level semantic version. The Git history is the changelog.
